[bounded cusp length under nonnegative area derivative] Source: cao-zhu 1. Claim 2\group Nonsingular Three-Dimensional Solutions If \[ (1+2\varepsilon _0)L-(1-\varepsilon _0)A\geq 0 \] then $L=L(\zeta )$ is uniformly bounded from above.
